title: Facebook shares spike on better-than-expected quarterly earnings
主要内容: Meta reported Q1 2022 earnings per share of $2.72, exceeding analyst expectations of $2.56. Revenue fell short of forecasts at $27.91 billion versus $28.2 billion expected. Daily Active Users (DAUs) rose to 1.96 billion from 1.93 billion in the previous quarter. The stock declined nearly 50% year-to-date following the earnings report. Meta reported Q1 2022 earnings, with revenue rising 7%, marking the first time in its 10-year history as a public company that growth has landed in the single digits. Analysts expected 7.8% growth. For Q2, Meta forecast revenue of $28 billion to $30 billion, below the $30.6 billion estimate. The company noted continued soft revenue growth, coinciding with the war in Ukraine. Facebook's apps, including Instagram and WhatsApp, accounted for 97.5% of revenue.
